doc.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Subbing on The Tonight Show and other TV shows
summary: He subbed under Allen, Parr, and Carson, and played other shows.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Oh, I was cutting my own throat. I did – I don’t know if I mentioned to you. I did – when The Tonight Show – I did that show as a substitute when – what’s-his-name was there. Who was there? Before Jack Parr – Steve Allen.
When Steve Allen was there. He was in charge of it. I worked over there as a sub on that show. Then I . . . .
That as fun. Let’s see. Who was conducting? Milton DeLugg was his conductor. Then I subbed over there when Jack Parr took over, with José Melis. Then when Steve Allen . . . .
Was this when Clark Terry was in the band? Or did he . . . ?

This was a couple times before Clark went on staff, he and Snooky Young. Then I was over there with Johnny Carson. I subbed on the Carson show with Skitch Henderson. So it’s funny that I had done The Tonight Show from – with everybody that was on there. It’s kind of amusing.
And now Wynton Marsalis’s brother is leading the band over there, Branford Marsalis.
Then I used to do the United Cerebral Palsy thing with Tony Cabot. We did Howard Cosell’s sports show with Elliot Lawrence. He had a television show. We did that.
Yeah. We did that. We used to do it at the CBS studio, at the Ed Sullivan Theater, but it was an ABC show. We also did – used to do – I did – what’s his name?
